reviewer: Codex coordinator, direct inspection of eight published reference/candidate images
same_scene_limit: References and candidates use the same rooms/courses, but are not identical poses/positions. The source also changes the road field and prop mounting. This is a contextual comparison, not pixel-isolated attribution or evidence of complete target retirement.
producer_review_scope: Producer local_visual_review.json uses five provisional dimensions at 4.5. Those attributed scores are not ten-axis coordinator scores, owner approval or formal QA11.

roles.name: Floating shell item capsule

axes.contour: Rounded aqua scallop capsule with violet pearl clasp replaces the generic pickup motif in the inspected source candidate. This is a distinct item-roll identity rather than currency.
axes.material: The candidates show broad painted value bands appropriate to shell, kelp, cloth, blocks and ceramic. They are provisional usable texture candidates; the source floor, road markings and HUD remain separately unresolved visible art.
axes.palette: Aqua, mint, lilac, warm cream and restrained gold harmonize with the viewed room palettes and existing kart. These are state-local observations, not a whole-source color average.
axes.light: Painted highlights and cool shadows read in the inspected room composites. Exact Mobile/Speedy on-device presentation and all placements are unreviewed.
axes.perspective: The still sprites are consumed by the existing true-Canvas projected Racer. Viewed room cues support their pictorial placement; no all-camera or near-plane perspective acceptance is granted.
axes.scale: The viewed props are readable in posed 1280x720 views. The inspected block view also shows a very large translucent tent across the upper scene/road; near-camera scale/fade and split-view mounts remain open.
axes.contact: Capsules float; kelp lies low on the lane; room ornaments are roadside. Posed images alone do not establish support, every route position, contact during action or physical-device behavior.
axes.occlusion: Inspected objects sit among authored room art and the kart/HUD. Foreground tent translucency in prop-play_blocks is an unresolved composition observation; no whole-course occlusion pass is claimed.
axes.readability: Shell clasp, teapot handle/spout, tent opening, block stack and seahorse form are recognizable in the inspected views. Child comprehension, phone-scale split views, rewards and state transitions remain open.
axes.action_state: These seven are static object candidates with engine-driven placement/state. Indexed views are posed diagnostics. Cooldown, item use, repeats, natural input journey and full route/state QA11 require separate evidence. Floating silhouette and approach/cooldown states need complete natural-route and phone review.
